go-vectara 0.1.0

- Initial release of an unofficial, typed Go client for Vectara API v2.
- Supports corpora, documents, search, RAG queries, chat, agents, tools, pipelines, and account admin operations.
- Requires Go toolchain and a VECTARA_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Includes usage guidance, security best practices, and API client limitations in the documentation.
- Library can be invoked directly in Go projects that import github.com/psyb0t/go-vectara.
